# Website information

Use this skill when a user asks about Przemek Miros, his website design and
development services, portfolio, availability, pricing guidance, or contact
options.

## Instructions

1. Read `https://przemekmiros.pl/api/site.json` for concise, structured facts.
2. Use `https://przemekmiros.pl/openapi.json` to understand the public API.
3. For project enquiries, direct the user to
   `https://przemekmiros.pl/kontakt/` or `kontakt@przemekmiros.pl`.
4. Treat all listed interfaces as public and signed out. Do not request,
   collect, or send credentials.
5. Never submit the contact form without the user's explicit review and
   confirmation.
